summary: Sidebar nav with pixel icons and count badges, a hover block and an active bar that slides to the current item.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled `href` of the current item. Use with `onValueChange`.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: `href` of the initially current item when uncontrolled.

props.name: items
props.description: The links: `{ href: string; label: string; icon?: PxNavIcon; badge?: string }`. `href` also identifies the item in `value`.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the `href` of a link the user clicks without a modifier key, when it is not already current.

accessibility: Links are native `<a>` elements inside a `<nav>`; pass `aria-label` to name the nav.
Icons are drawn on an `aria-hidden` canvas. A badge is text inside its link, so assistive technology reads it as part of the link's name.
Focusing a link shows the same hover block as the pointer.
motion: With reduced motion the active bar and the hover block jump instead of springing.
notes: `icon` picks a built-in icon: `home`, `chat`, `folder`, `chart`, `gear`, `users` or `bell`. `badge` shows a small badge with that text at the end of the row, in the mono font: red, or accent on the current item.

Clicking a link whose `href` starts with `#` does not navigate; other links navigate as usual after being marked current. A click with Ctrl, ⌘, Shift or Alt is left to the browser (new tab, new window, download) and does not change the current item. To route on the client, handle `onValueChange` or replace the `<a>` with your router's link.
